label: Neufchâtel (US)
note: The American Neufchâtel is an unripened cream cheese with less fat and more moisture than cream cheese, not the French mould-ripened Neufchâtel (see Bloomy-rind)

about.text: A factory-made, unaged cream cheese with about a third less fat and more moisture than regular cream cheese, softer and sold as the reduced-fat choice. It is not the French Neufchâtel, a Normandy PDO cheese ripened under white mould for 8–10 weeks.
